name: Konnyaku
description: Grey rubbery jelly from konjac corm — almost no calories, and almost no flavour.

tcm.note: Konjac appears in the Chinese record as cold and detoxifying.

ayurveda.note: Shita and very heavy to move; it is nearly all fibre and water.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with the starchy tubers, though it is barely a food.

histamine.note: Very low — one of the safest foods on the list, being mostly water and fibre.
